title: SmartMem: Layout Transformation Elimination and Adaptation for Efficient DNN Execution on Mobile
problem: Layout transformations between computational operators cause significant slowdown in DNN inference on mobile devices, particularly for transformers and large models like Stable Diffusion and LLMs.
motivation: Efficient inference of modern transformers and large language models on mobile devices is critical for enabling edge deployment and real-time applications.
method: SmartMem classifies operators into four groups and optimizes producer-consumer relationships to enable shared tensor layouts across the network. It develops efficient memory layout designs for 2.5D memory architectures common in mobile devices and uses systematic search methods to find layout configurations that minimize transformation overhead.
key_novelty: Comprehensive framework that eliminates layout transformations by coordinating tensor layouts and operator implementations across the entire DNN computation graph to enable operators to share the same memory layout.
contributions: Framework for systematically eliminating layout transformations in mobile DNN execution
Operator classification and producer-consumer optimization strategy for layout compatibility
Efficient 2.5D memory layout designs tailored to mobile device memory hierarchies
Speedups of 2.8× over DNNFusion, 6.9× over TVM, and 7.9× over MNN on average across 18 neural networks

metrics.speedup: 2.8× over DNNFusion, 6.9× over TVM, 7.9× over MNN (average)
metrics.other: Evaluated on 18 neural networks including CNNs, Transformers with local and global attention, and LLMs

primary_theme: Mobile DNN optimization through layout transformation elimination
